concerns.text: FR-001 requires downloading the global NOAA NCEP/NCAR daily surface pressure data. No task in tasks.md implements this download; the only related task (T011a) fetches a verified test dataset and logs DEV‑001 when the global source is missing. A concrete task to acquire the full global dataset is absent, leaving the functional requirement uncovered.

FR-002 mandates interpolation of the coarse pressure fields to a fine‑resolution grid. The task list contains land‑mask generation (T013a) and ocean‑mask application (T013b) but no task that performs the required pressure‑field interpolation and grid‑resolution up‑sampling. Consequently the interpolation requirement is not covered.

FR-011 specifies stratification of control windows by ENSO/PDO climate indices. The current implementation (T025) uses a proxy control‑window with a flag `PROXY_NOT_FULFILLING_FR011` and references DEV‑002, indicating a deferred placeholder. No task provides the actual climate‑index stratification, so the requirement remains unmet.
